guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 漏聲傳播、到時定位與不確定度驗證。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Leak-noise propagation, time-delay location and uncertainty validation. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.040 s，x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m，自A沿管量測；至B為120 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=0.040 s、速度誤差δa=+100 m/s，δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m；另有1 ms時差偏移可造成0.50 m位置偏移。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s, not an inference from loudness.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, a=1000 m/s and Δt=0.040 s. x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m along the pipe from A, leaving 120 m to B.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=0.040 s and speed error δa=+100 m/s. δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m. A separate 1 ms delay offset at a=1000 m/s produces a 0.50 m shift.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s. At a=1000 m/s, one-sample location scale aΔts/2=0.25 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Wavelength λ=a/f=4.0 m; this is not leak-location resolution.
timeline: 2010　美國環保署發布配水水損控制技術指南，整理測漏與計量。
2017　香港屋苑地下公用水管測漏指引首版發行，包含聲學相關。
2021　青衣Q-Leak中心於七月啟用，提供多材質模擬漏點訓練。
timelineEn: 2010 — EPA publishes guidance on distribution water losses, metering and detection.
2017 — Hong Kong issues the first estate communal-service leak guideline, including correlation.
2021 — Tsing Yi Q-Leak opens in July with varied-material simulated leak training.

procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出水深或斷面、流域水文、消能與防護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, catchment hydrology, energy dissipation and protection system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：輸水管線洩漏聲學定位
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Acoustic leak location in water mains
guides.concept: 本課將漏水聲源、傳播速度、雙點到時差與管內追蹤串成完整定位問題，特別分析同步誤差、取樣、頻帶、衰減及共同干擾。學徒須區分漏水存在、位置與流量三種證據，再以盲測和修復回饋檢查方法的真正成效，不以單一漂亮相關峰作結論。
guides.conceptEn: This course connects leak-sound generation, propagation speed, two-sensor delay and inline tracking into a complete location problem, examining synchronization, sampling, frequency bands, attenuation and shared interference. Learners distinguish evidence of leak presence, location and flow, then use blinded tests and repair feedback to assess actual performance instead of relying on one attractive correlation peak.
procedure: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。裂縫形狀、土壤包覆、管材及水壓會同時改變水力與聲學耦合；較大的漏口也可能產生較低頻或較弱的聲音，因此不能按音量直接排序所有漏失量。孔口式只估給定幾何與係數下的流量，不預測聲壓級；裂縫面積隨壓力變動時，固定孔口模型也需重新檢核。
同一漏聲沿管線往兩端傳播，兩支感測器的到時差可把聲源限制在已知管段內。座標方向與延遲符號必須明確，否則同一數值會得到鏡像位置；管長應沿實際管路量測而不是兩測點的地表直線距離，分支與材質變化則可能使單速模型不再適用。定義x自感測器A量起、Δt=tB−tA，且聲源位於A與B之間；兩側共用相同波速時才有此代數關係。
聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。若某一已知聲源位置可提供到時差，便能反推單段有效速度；但管長、感測器時間同步與聲源位置都必須獨立可信，否則校準會把其他誤差吸收到速度參數內。當已知聲源靠近兩感測器中點，延遲趨近零，反算速度會對時間誤差極敏感；不能把這種配置當作高品質校準。
定位公式把管長、速度及延遲誤差一起傳到位置，誤差的來源與相關性必須分開。固定時間偏移會沿同一方向移動全部結果，而隨機雜訊會使重複估計散布；只報演算法相關峰的寬度，不能涵蓋管材速度或儀器時鐘的系統偏差。下式是一階局部敏感度，固定管長與延遲，只改變速度；若多個參數同時變動，需保留交互關係及可能共同偏差。
離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。抗混疊濾波、訊號頻寬、感測器耦合及雜訊決定可用資訊，次取樣插值也不能憑空創造遺失頻率；應分開理論格點尺度與經驗證的現地誤差。本例假設均勻波速且只考慮一個取樣間隔的延遲變化，不包含頻寬限制與峰值估計誤差，也不是可保證的定位精度。
不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。高頻通常提供較短的時間特徵，但不一定能傳到遠端；濾波選擇若只追求最尖的峰，可能選到機械噪聲或與單速假設不相容的頻段。波長公式只連結某頻率與其對應相速度，不把波長當定位誤差；存在色散時，不同頻帶須使用相容的傳播模型。
漏聲到達感測器前會經過管壁、接頭與地層，傳播損失和接觸耦合都可能降低振幅。兩測點訊號差異不一定代表一端離漏點更遠，鬆動的感測器或不同閥件可造成額外損失；衰減模型應以相同安裝與頻帶比較，不能把單次振幅比直接解成距離。指數衰減是單一頻帶、均勻路徑的教學模型，α為振幅衰減係數；功率比需平方，不能混用二十分貝與十分貝定義。
兩訊號具有共同頻率成分並不證明共同來源就是漏水，泵、交通或電氣干擾也可能同時被兩通道接收。平方相干性衡量線性頻域關聯，可協助篩選可信頻帶，但缺乏來源身分資訊；需要改變測點、比對設備時序與獨立水力證據，才能縮小聲源假說。計算的自譜與互譜須使用相同窗函數、尺度與頻率格點；相干值介於零與一，並不是漏水存在的機率。
管內感測器接近漏聲來源，可減少部分外部耦合問題，但聲音時間戳仍須轉換成沿管位置。工具速度不必等於斷面平均流速，停留、翻轉與分岔都會影響軌跡；只有把通過已知位置的事件與移動模型連結，才能避免聲音特徵被標在錯誤管段。恆速乘時間只描述已知工具速度的理想區段，不可直接以水流速度代替；實際定位需使用獨立通過標記或其他追蹤資料。
檢測成效需要同時考慮找出的真漏點、假警報及漏掉的漏點，單純命中比例不足以描述整套方法。驗證樣本還必須包含不同管材、背景噪聲與無漏水區段，否則訓練場表現無法代表現場；修復後的壓力正規化水量與聲音改變可提供額外證據，但仍需排除需求改變。精確率以所有警報作分母，召回率以所有已知真漏點作分母；本例的完整真值來自假設盲測，實際未開挖區不能當成已知無漏。
procedureEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. Leakage rate and audible strength are not in a one-to-one relationship. Crack geometry, surrounding soil, pipe material and pressure affect hydraulic and acoustic coupling together. A larger opening can produce lower-frequency or weaker sound, so loudness cannot rank every leak by discharge. The orifice expression estimates flow for specified geometry and coefficient, not acoustic level. If crack area changes with pressure, the fixed-opening model also requires reassessment.

A leak signal travels toward both ends of a pipe, and its arrival-time difference constrains the source within a known reach. Coordinate direction and delay sign must be explicit or the same number yields a mirrored location. Length follows the actual pipe rather than a straight surface distance, while branches and material transitions can invalidate a single-speed model. Define x from sensor A and Δt=tB−tA, with the source between A and B. The algebraic relation requires the same wave speed on both sides.

Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. A known source position and delay can calibrate one reach. Pipe length, sensor synchronization and source location must independently be trustworthy, however, or calibration merely absorbs their errors into the speed parameter. For a known source near the sensor midpoint, delay approaches zero and inferred speed becomes highly sensitive to timing error. That geometry is unsuitable as strong calibration evidence.

The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct. A fixed timing offset shifts all results in one direction, whereas random noise spreads repeated estimates. Correlation-peak width alone cannot cover systematic bias in material wave speed or instrument clocks. The expression is a first-order local sensitivity, holding length and delay fixed while changing speed. Simultaneous parameter changes require their dependence and possible common bias to be retained.

Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy. Anti-alias filtering, signal bandwidth, sensor coupling and noise determine usable information. Subsample interpolation cannot recreate missing frequencies, so theoretical grid resolution must be distinguished from validated field error. The example assumes uniform speed and considers one sample interval of delay only. It excludes bandwidth and peak-estimation error and is not a guaranteed positioning accuracy.

Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. Higher frequencies may provide shorter temporal features but may not reach a distant sensor. Selecting filters solely for the sharpest peak can favor machinery noise or a band incompatible with the single-speed assumption. Wavelength links a frequency to its corresponding phase speed and is not a location-error measure. With dispersion, different bands need compatible propagation models.

Before reaching a sensor, leak sound passes through pipe walls, joints and surrounding ground, while both propagation loss and contact coupling reduce amplitude. Unequal signals do not necessarily mean one sensor is farther from the leak: loose attachment or different fittings can add loss. Attenuation comparisons require matched installation and band, rather than interpreting one amplitude ratio directly as distance. Exponential decay is a teaching model for one band and uniform path, with α an amplitude attenuation coefficient. Power ratios are squared, so amplitude and power decibel definitions must not be mixed.

Shared frequency content does not prove that the common source is a leak: pumps, traffic and electrical interference can reach both channels. Magnitude-squared coherence measures linear frequency-domain association and can help select useful bands, but it does not identify the source. Changed sensor geometry, equipment timing and independent hydraulic evidence are needed to constrain competing source hypotheses. Auto- and cross-spectra must use compatible windows, scaling and frequency bins. Coherence lies between zero and one but is not the probability that a leak exists.

An inline sensor approaches the acoustic source and can reduce some external coupling problems, but signal timestamps still require conversion into along-pipe position. Tool speed need not equal section-average water velocity; pauses, rotation and branches affect its trajectory. Linking passages at known locations to the motion model prevents acoustic features from being assigned to the wrong reach. Speed times time describes an ideal reach with known tool speed and cannot substitute water velocity without evidence. Real positioning needs independent passage markers or other tracking data.

Detection performance includes true detections, false alarms and missed leaks, so one hit fraction cannot describe the whole method. Validation also needs different materials, background noise and leak-free reaches; training performance cannot automatically represent field conditions. Pressure-normalized flow and acoustic changes after repair provide additional evidence, while demand changes still need to be excluded. Precision uses all alarms, while recall uses all known real leaks. Complete truth is assumed for this blind-test example; unexcavated field areas cannot simply be labeled leak-free.
evidence: 比較相同孔口在兩個假設壓差下的流量，另列聲源與傳播尚需哪些資料。要求調查報告分開漏水存在、位置與流量三種結論，不讓聲音證據超出可支持範圍。
畫出聲源到兩端的傳播路徑，用各自距離除以波速重新求延遲，反查定位結果。再交換感測器名稱，確認物理位置不變而座標與延遲符號一致轉換。
比較已知聲源位於偏中與正中時的反算條件，說明為何小延遲不利校準。把速度寫成有證據支持的範圍，再觀察位置區間如何隨範圍擴大。
對同一定位結果分別加入速度偏差與時差偏移，標示兩者移動方向。寫出包含共同偏差的搜尋區間，並說明哪一項額外量測最能縮小區間。
把一個取樣間隔換算成位置格點，另列速度與同步誤差作比較。設計可驗證的已知延遲測試，讓報告中的解析度與準確度使用不同欄位。
evidenceEn: Compare one hypothetical opening at two pressure differences and list additional source and propagation information needed. Keep conclusions about leak presence, location and flow separate so acoustic evidence is not overstated.

Draw propagation paths to both sensors and recompute delay from each distance divided by speed. Then exchange sensor names, confirming that the physical location stays fixed while coordinates and delay sign transform consistently.

Compare calibration geometry for an off-center and a centered known source, explaining why small delay is unfavorable. Express speed as an evidence-based range and examine how the inferred location interval expands.

Add speed bias and timing offset separately to one location estimate, marking their shift directions. Report a search interval that includes common bias and identify the additional measurement most capable of narrowing it.

Convert one sample interval into a position-grid scale and compare it with speed and synchronization errors. Design a known-delay verification so resolution and accuracy appear in separate report fields.
pitfalls: 只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。
把混合材質管路的校準速度套到全線，可能讓不同測段得到互不相容的位置；若校準聲源位置本身有誤，反算仍可能看似精確卻帶有共同偏差。
高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。
感測器接觸不良可能被誤解成管線高度衰減，導致過早否定聲學方法；反之把良好耦合的單點優勢當成較近漏源，也會使位置判讀偏向錯誤方向。
用水量計推得的平均流速直接定位工具，可能在停滯後累積很大位置誤差；即使漏聲判識正確，錯誤軌跡仍會把修復目標移到另一支管節。
pitfallsEn: Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage. Incorrect discharge ranking then directs investigation and repair resources away from the actual loss.

Applying one calibrated speed across mixed materials can produce incompatible locations from different reaches. If the calibration source position is itself wrong, the fitted speed can appear precise while carrying a shared bias.

A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. High-frequency interference lacking anti-alias control can also fold into lower frequencies and create a stable false correlation peak.

Poor sensor contact can be mistaken for severe pipe attenuation and lead to premature rejection of acoustics. Conversely, interpreting one well-coupled sensor’s stronger signal as proximity to the leak biases location in the wrong direction.
Locating a tool directly from bulk-meter velocity can accumulate large errors after a pause. Even a correctly identified leak signal then points repair activity toward the wrong pipe section.

related.title: 配水系統分區計量
related.transfer: 可遷移「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」與「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；配水系統分區計量的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" and "Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of District-metered water-distribution networks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦漏聲傳播、到時定位與不確定度驗證；配水系統分區計量則以分區水量帳、計量誤差與可比漏失基線為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on leak-noise propagation, time-delay location and uncertainty validation; District-metered water-distribution networks centres on district water balances, measurement errors and comparable loss baselines, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「漏口能量與聲源形成」與「分區水量平衡邊界」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到配水系統分區計量，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「多水表時間對齊機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Leak energy and acoustic generation” and “District water-balance boundary”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to District-metered water-distribution networks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Time alignment across meters mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 輸水管線洩漏聲學定位
history.titleEn: Acoustic leak location in water mains
history.text: 聲學測漏的發展從聽音經驗延伸到雙點相關、數位訊號與可追溯驗證。美國環保署2010年水損指南整理計量及測漏方法，香港水務署2017年屋苑指引則說明調查與修復後驗證。青衣Q-Leak訓練中心於2021年七月啟用，以不同管材及模擬漏點提供可控制的訓練環境；香港智管網另提供分區水量和壓力背景。兩者是互補的調查尺度，本課不把訓練命中率當成全城市管網準確率，也不宣稱每一種感測方式已用於所有區域。
history.textEn: Acoustic leak work has expanded from listening experience into correlation, digital signals and traceable validation. EPA’s 2010 water-loss guide surveys metering and detection, while Hong Kong’s 2017 estate guideline addresses investigation and verification after repair. The Tsing Yi Q-Leak centre opened in July 2021, using varied materials and simulated leaks for controlled training. Hong Kong’s Water Intelligent Network supplies separate district-flow and pressure context. These are complementary investigation scales; the course does not equate training hit rates with city-wide accuracy or claim every sensing method is installed in every district.
